text:
maria: Hey team — PR #4821 ready for sec review. Small change to projected SA token flow for on-prem (reduces long-lived secrets). Need quick check for KMS proxy and VPC egress. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821

maria: TL;DR: swap static secret -> k8s projected serviceAccountToken, add REDWOOD_KMS_ENDPOINT env var, minimal deployment.yaml edits. No new external deps.

kevin: can you paste the deployment snippet? :eyes:

maria: ```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: runtime
        env:
        - name: REDWOOD_KMS_ENDPOINT
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: kms-proxy-credentials
              key: endpoint
        volumeMounts:
        - name: sa-token
          mountPath: /var/run/secrets/tokens
      volumes:
      - name: sa-token
        projected:
          sources:
          - serviceAccountToken:
              path: token
              expirationSeconds: 3600
```

jess: Quick q — expirationSeconds 3600 (1h) ok. Does this change require HSM or key rotation? Also we need an audit log note and ensure we never accidentally print the token. :mag:

maria: No HSM changes. KMS proxy still talks to customer-managed KEK in VPC; no rotation changes required. Added a log-guard in runtime to redact any env vars named "token". I'll add an audit entry in the runbook.

ben: Infra +1, but we should canary in us-west-2 and validate egress policy (kms-proxy only to customer's endpoint). Also please gate behind feature flag `proj-sa-pp` for quick rollback.

maria: will add the feature flag. plan: ship to staging canary, run smoke tests, then merge to main if green. aiming for EOD.

sec-bot: Automated secrets scan for PR #4821: no plaintext secrets detected. SCA: low risk.

jess: I'll do a quick read now. If nothing weird I'll approve in ~90m. please add a 1-paragraph rollback plan and smoke test checklist.

maria: adding runbook now. smoke tests = auth handshake, kv write/read, simple inference e2e. will ping when staging deploy is up.
